caller_is_owner.meaning: the caller of increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() is the contract owner (onlyOwner)

mev_monitors_calls.meaning: an MEV bot monitors the mempool for increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() calls

held_transaction_executes.meaning: the MEV-bot-held increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() transaction still executes after being held for 1 hour, 1 day, 1 week, or 1 month
held_transaction_executes.checkpoint: after the reported hold period elapses

deadline_expiry_rejects.meaning: a caller-provided deadline is present and the transaction is rejected once block.timestamp exceeds that deadline
deadline_expiry_rejects.checkpoint: at execution time after the reported hold period elapses

assumptions: The held transaction is an increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() call submitted by the owner and observed by the MEV bot.
The reported hold durations (1 hour, 1 day, 1 week, 1 month) are alternative scenarios, not simultaneous conditions.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a concrete caller-provided deadline value or the block.timestamp at which the held transaction executes, so the expiry comparison cannot be numerically bound; the impact is encoded as the observable execution-after-hold outcome.

limitations: Stale-pricing execution and MEV profit impacts are not formalized in this plan; only indefinite_execution is targeted.
The report describes the held execution as potential, not an observed transaction.
